app.name: Ikimina
app.tagline: Your savings group, clear and fair

validation.phone: Enter a Rwandan mobile number, for example 0788 123 456.
validation.otp: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
validation.amount: Enter an amount in RWF, for example 5000.
validation.days: Enter a number of days from 0 to 365.
validation.terms: Please accept the terms to continue.

errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords and your phone number.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms and the privacy policy
register.termsDraft: The terms and privacy policy are still being prepared.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.sentTo: If {{phone}} can be used, we have sent it a 6-digit code by SMS.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your phone number. If it has an account, we will send it a code.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

reauth.title: Confirm your password
reauth.intro: For your security, enter your password again to continue.

mine.title: My groups
mine.empty: You are not in a group yet. Start one, or ask a group officer to invite your phone number.

create.title: Start a group
create.hint: You will be the group's President. You can invite members next.
create.name: Group name

home.stepOffices: Make sure the Treasurer and Secretary are set

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.officeNote: Offices change hands only by transfer, so a group always keeps its officers.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: We send an SMS with a link. Only the invited phone number can use it, and it expires after 7 days.

accept.title: Join a group
accept.intro: You were invited to join a savings group. Sign in with the phone number that received the SMS, then join.
accept.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Ask the group for a new invitation.

settings.title: Group rules
settings.readOnly: Only the President, Treasurer and Secretary can change the rules.
settings.withdrawalNoticeDays: Notice before a withdrawal or exit (days)
settings.moneyRulesNote: Changes to money rules need a second officer to confirm them.
settings.proposed: Your change is waiting for another officer to confirm it.
settings.pendingTitle: A change is waiting for confirmation

offices.title: Transfer of office
offices.intro: Hand your office to another member. Nothing changes until they accept.
offices.offered: Offer sent. It takes effect when they accept.
offices.notHolder: Only an office holder can offer their office.
